title: Racing Mania
one_line: Dodge oncoming traffic across three lanes and rack up distance before you crash.
how_to_play: Steer left and right to dodge traffic and stay on the road. Arrow keys on desktop, on-screen left/right buttons on mobile.
description: A real 3D lane-dodging car racer (Three.js, third-person chase camera) with a saved best score, five car colors that unlock as you beat your best, and traffic that gets faster the longer you survive.
